user.title: Search USGS Stream Gauges
user.description:
Search by stream or station name, or paste a USGS site number directly (e.g. 06710247).

[Find gauges on the USGS Water Resources site]({usgs_url})

data_description.search_term: Part of a stream name (e.g. "Bear Creek") or a USGS 8-digit site number
data_description.state_code: Required for name searches — two-letter US state abbreviation (e.g. CO, CA, WA). Not needed when entering a site number directly.

select_site.title: Select a Gauge Station
select_site.description: Found {count} matching stations. Stations may show as Unavailable in winter if seasonally decommissioned.

data_description.api_key: Optional api.data.gov key for the upcoming modernized USGS API. The current data source doesn't require it — leave blank to use a shared, rate-limited demo key when the new API is enabled. Get a free key at {signup_url}.

reauth_confirm.title: Update USGS API key
reauth_confirm.description: The Modern (Water Data OGC API) backend rejected the api.data.gov key for this gauge. Enter a valid key to continue. Get a free key at {signup_url}.

data_description.api_key: Your api.data.gov key for the Modern USGS Water Data OGC API.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the USGS API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: The USGS API rejected that key. Check the api.data.gov key and try again.
error.no_sites_found: No active stream gauges matched. Try a broader name or a different state code.
error.search_required: Please enter a stream name or site number.
error.state_required_for_name_search: A state code is required when searching by name (e.g. CO). To search nationwide, enter a site number directly instead.

abort.already_configured: This gauge station is already configured.

init.title: USGS Streamflow Options
init.description: Adjust how often data is polled and which measurements appear as sensors. Only parameters the station actually reports will create sensors.

data_description.api_key: Optional api.data.gov key for the upcoming modernized USGS API. Leave blank to use a shared, rate-limited demo key when the new API is enabled. Get a free key at {signup_url}. Changing this reloads the integration.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to poll USGS. Instantaneous data refreshes about every 15 minutes, so lower values add load without new data.
data_description.enabled_parameters: Unchecked parameters won't create sensors even if the station reports them. Changing this reloads the integration.
data_description.enable_stats: Add Condition, Percentile, and % of Normal sensors for discharge and depth-to-water by comparing the live reading to ~30 years of daily history (the USGS WaterWatch / Groundwater Watch view). The first build downloads the long-term record per gauge, then caches it. Changing this reloads the integration.
data_description.backend: Which USGS API to poll. Legacy (WaterServices) is the stable default; Modern (Water Data OGC API) is the in-progress replacement and needs an API key. Switch one entry to Modern to compare it against Legacy. Changing this reloads the integration.

demo_key.title: USGS Streamflow is using the shared demo API key
demo_key.description: This gauge polls the Modern (Water Data OGC API) backend with the shared, rate-limited api.data.gov demo key, so updates may be throttled. Get a free personal key at {signup_url} and set it in the integration's options to remove the limit.

legacy_backend.title: USGS legacy API is being retired
legacy_backend.description: This gauge still polls the legacy USGS WaterServices API, which USGS is decommissioning (planned for early 2027) — and a future update will remove it entirely. To keep this gauge working, switch it to the Modern backend now: enable **Advanced Mode** in your Home Assistant profile, open the integration's **Configure** dialog, set **Data source** to **Modern**, and add a free api.data.gov key ({signup_url}).

gw_depth_pct_of_normal.name: Depth to Water Level % of Normal

http_status.message: The USGS API returned HTTP {status} for site {site_id}.

response_format.message: The USGS API returned an unexpected response: {error}.

communication.message: Error communicating with the USGS API: {error}.

invalid_auth.message: The USGS API rejected the api.data.gov key. Update the key to reconnect.
